lead.event: Rupiah falls to record lows against the US dollar
lead.headline: Rupiah falls to reported record lows as year-to-date loss reaches 8.94%
lead.blurb: Reports put the closing rate at Rp18,332 and Rp18,319 per US dollar, both described as record lows. MSCI’s consultation on reclassifying Indonesia to Standalone Market status runs through 30 April 2027, with a decision due by 30 June. The rupiah was forecast to fluctuate between Rp18,330 and Rp18,400 per US dollar in the next session.

market_structure_policy.event: OJK issues stricter risk-based capital rules for insurers
market_structure_policy.headline: OJK issues stricter insurer capital rules, keeps 120% RBC minimum
market_structure_policy.blurb: The new method takes effect for first-quarter 2027 reports and tailors calculations to each insurer’s risks. Shareholder loans count toward capital only up to the company’s own capital. OJK trials at 10 insurers produced lower ratios for most, while analyst Gromy Purba said some firms may need to add capital.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: Merdeka Copper Gold sets aside funds to repay a December bond
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: MDKA prepares Rp1.29 trillion for December bond repayment
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Merdeka Copper Gold has prepared funds for the principal and 12th interest installment on its Series B bonds, which carry a fixed 9.5% rate. It will deposit the funds with KSEI before the 15 December maturity, and says repayment will have no material impact on its operations, financial condition or business continuity.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: Indocement Tunggal Prakarsa launches a share buyback
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: INTP launches buyback worth up to Rp750 billion
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Indocement will fund the buyback entirely from internal funds, capped at 10% of paid-in capital. The period runs from 22 May 2026 to 21 May 2027, and the withdrawal of 84.53 million treasury shares has been approved.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: Cakra Buana Resources plans rights issue to convert promissory note receivables
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: CBRE plans rights issue of up to 48 billion shares
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Cakra Buana Resources proposes using the proceeds to convert Rp858.59 billion of promissory note payables, including Rp354.06 billion owed to Garuda Nusantara Mineral. The company expects the conversion to reduce liabilities and increase equity. Shareholders are due to vote on the plan at an extraordinary meeting on 16 December 2026.

deals_control.event: Solusi Sinergi Digital explains reversal of a shareholder-group share transfer
deals_control.headline: WIFI explains reversal of Rp4.06 trillion share transfer
deals_control.blurb: Solusi Sinergi Digital said 1.42 billion shares moved from Sinergi Graha Kapital back to controlling shareholder Investasi Sukses Bersama on 19 November at Rp2,870 each, reversing an equal 19 October transfer. It said both transactions restructured shareholder-group ownership without a price adjustment or gain or loss. The company denied they were a repurchase or financing arrangement.

deals_control.event: Harta Djaya Karya plans a rights issue to acquire a coal-miner stake
deals_control.headline: MEJA plans Rp1.11 trillion rights issue for 45% coal-miner stake
deals_control.blurb: Trimata Coal Perkasa has 400 million tons of reserves across an 11,640-hectare concession. Harta Djaya Karya expects TCP shareholders to absorb about 70% of new shares at an indicative Rp450–Rp550 per share. Independent valuation and approvals remain pending, with a shareholder meeting targeted for February 2027.
deals_control.copy_decision: rewritten: moved from lead to story

deals_control.event: DMS Propertindo plans a rights issue to acquire two property companies
deals_control.headline: KOTA plans Rp4.95 trillion rights issue to acquire two property companies
deals_control.blurb: Non-exercising DMS Propertindo shareholders may face dilution of up to 90.31%. The company plans to use Rp4.4 trillion to buy 99.99% of Art Design Indonesia for Rp1.2 trillion and Mandirinusa Graha Perkasa for Rp3.2 trillion. Shareholders are due to vote on the plan at an extraordinary meeting on 27 November.
deals_control.copy_decision: rewritten: moved from flash to story

earnings_guidance.event: Telkom restates and reports first-half 2026 financial results
earnings_guidance.headline: TLKM restates first-half results as attributable profit falls 7.67% to Rp9.96 trillion
earnings_guidance.blurb: The restatement cut operating profit by Rp758 billion to Rp19.38 trillion. KAP Purwanto Susanti dan Surja reviewed the interim statements on 24 November and found no material misstatement.
earnings_guidance.copy_decision: rewritten: 3 new articles with a new fact: The restatement reduced operating profit by Rp758 billion to Rp19.38 trillion.

earnings_guidance.event: KB Valbury projects higher 2026 earnings and upside for Timah
earnings_guidance.headline: KB Valbury projects TINS 2026 profit at Rp5.2 trillion
earnings_guidance.blurb: KB Valbury expects Timah’s earnings to rise 300% from Rp1.3 trillion in 2025, while its target price implies up to 60% potential gain. The broker says sustained re-rating depends on sales volume growth and COGS matching estimates as tin prices normalize.

earnings_guidance.event: Mirae Asset rates ESSA Accumulative Buy after Q3 earnings
earnings_guidance.headline: Mirae rates ESSA Accumulative Buy with Rp675 target
earnings_guidance.blurb: ESSA’s Q3-2026 net profit rose 83.3% quarter on quarter to US$20.9 million as its ammonia plant normalized after scheduled Q2 maintenance. Mirae analyst Nafan Aji Gusta expects the recovery to support performance through Q4-2026 into 2027, with ammonia the main earnings driver.

earnings_guidance.event: Tugu Insurance reports nine-month 2026 profit growth
earnings_guidance.headline: TUGU reports nine-month profit up 17.4% to Rp495.15 billion
earnings_guidance.blurb: Tugu Insurance also recorded Insurance Service Revenue of Rp6.73 trillion, up 4.5% year on year, and Insurance Service Results of Rp602.04 billion, up 17.2%. President Director Adi Pramana said the company would continue its transformation through portfolio development, digital technology, risk management and human resource capabilities.
